title: Docking Station
keywords: Automates the recipe family of a calculator inserted in its special slot

blocks.text: Automates the recipe family of a calculator inserted in its special slot.

rows: Insert Basic, Scientific, Atomic or Flawless Calculator in the calculator slot.
Supply that device’s required ingredients in the inputs.
Provide the docking batch energy and output room.

blocks.text: With no recognized calculator installed, the recipe family is none. A charged device alone does not replace the station’s machine energy.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
